According to the course material, how many types of sampling risk are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of sampling risk: a. the risk that the auditor will conclude, in the case of test of control, that control risk is lower than it actually is, or in the case of substantive test, that a material error does not exist when in fact it does.
